subject: Add REUSE compliance for machine-readable licensing and SBOM generation (#3968)
reason: The change is licensing/CI metadata only: a new REUSE compliance GitHub Actions workflow, canonical license texts under LICENSES/, REUSE.toml, COPYING reformatting, a deps/README.md edit, and SPDX-identifier fixes inside source-file comment headers. No executable code, command behavior, reply format, replication, persistence, or tool behavior changes, so there is nothing a runtime scenario could exercise.
